Aisha: quick post-QBR note — thanks everyone who joined, want to capture the remaining slide handoffs + exec asks here
Miguel: thanks — main things: renewal risk flagged for Meridian (usage drop), need exec talking points + next-step owner
Tess: noted on Meridian. I can take owner for the renewal playbook bullets. will sync with sales.
Samir: can you add the usage chart to the appendix? current slide only shows monthly active hosts, need week-level dip highlighted
Aisha: yes please Samir — add a small sparkline + callout: 'usage dip mid-mar'
Jen (CS-Bot): Deck uploaded: https://redwood.internal/slides/qbr/1754023333-wedge-map.pptx — comments enabled :white_check_mark:
Miguel: awesome. next: enablement ask — sales wants 2-min demo clip + 3 key value bullets for execs
Tess: I can draft the 3 bullets. who can record the demo clip? Kara volunteered during the meeting? @Kara?
Kara: yep I can record a 90s clip tomorrow morning. will post link here and add closed captions
Aisha: action list so far:
- Meridian renewal bullets (owner: Tess)
- Usage appendix update (owner: Samir)
- 90s demo clip + captions (owner: Kara)
- Exec talking points for fallback policy (owner: Miguel)
Miguel: putting talking points into a 1-slide doc. ETA EOD today.
Tess: capture enablement dependencies: do we need an eng contact for the demo env? @Samir?
Samir: there is a staging token limit — need to extend by 48 hours. pinging eng oncall now: /cc @eng-oncall
Jen (CS-Bot): New task created: CS-1754 - Meridian renewal playbook draft — assignee: Tess — due: 2024-04-02
Aisha: renewal risk severity: medium-high. please include potential concession options and their cost delta in the playbook
Kara: recording slot booked 9:30am PT tomorrow, will use the new staging token once eng confirms
Miguel: also reminded execs to emphasize fallback to smaller-quant model variant for peak events — add as a talking bullet
Tess: will include concession appendix + suggested contract language (one-liner)
Samir: eng oncall responded: staging tokens extended until 4/4. leaving a note in the demo slide with token expiry
Aisha: capture feedback loop: we promised to solicit 3 customer quotes for the exec slide — who will reach out?
Kara: I can reach out to two champions and cc Tess for the third. will aim for 3 by Friday.
Miguel: once slides updated, pls run a quick dry-run (5–7m) with me and Aisha before sending to the execs
Aisha: schedule 15m dry-run on Friday 10:00am PT — invites to follow
Tess: noted. I'll drop the first draft in the deck and add a comment thread for review points
Aisha: perfect. any other risks we missed? action items + owners above — marking this thread as the single source for follow-ups. :memo:
Kara: tiny ask — can someone add a one-liner on onboarding ETA improvements for accounts in trial? helps the renewal narrative
Miguel: will add a 1-line 'onboarding ETA trend' to the health snapshot slide
Jen (CS-Bot): Reminder set: follow-up sync in 48h — thread will be archived after the dry-run is complete
Aisha: thanks team. closing loop: I'll post the final slide link here after the dry-run. :rocket:
